<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Where Are You From?|id=A0007}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
Yes, this is about the easiest way to find something to talk about: asking where people are from. Invaluable small talk strategies offered by Liliana and JP. Keywords are '''Perú''' – Peru and '''Colombia''' – Colombia.
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0006|A0006: How's it going?]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0047|A0047: Coffee time]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0082|A0082: My name is...]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''¿De dónde eres?'''
| Where are you from?
| '''Soy de Perú. ¿Y tú?'''
| I'm from Peru. And you?
| '''Yo soy de Colombia.'''
| I'm from Colombia.
| '''¡Qué bien!'''
| How nice!
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''¿De dónde eres?'''
| Where are you from?
| '''Soy de Perú. ¿Y tú?'''
| I'm from Peru. And you?
| '''Yo soy de Colombia.'''
| I'm from Colombia.
| '''¡Qué bien!'''
| How nice!
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| Where are you from? | '''¿De dónde eres?'''
| I'm from Peru. And you? | '''Soy de Perú. ¿Y tú?'''
| I'm from Colombia. | '''Yo soy de Colombia.'''
| How nice! | '''¡Qué bien!'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Where are you from? | '''¿De dónde eres?'''
| I'm from Peru. And you? | '''Soy de Perú. ¿Y tú?'''
| I'm from Colombia. | '''Yo soy de Colombia.'''
| How nice! | '''¡Qué bien!'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Where are you from? | '''¿De dónde eres?'''
| Where am I from? | '''¿De dónde soy?'''
| From Peru, from Colombia, ...? | '''¿De Perú, de Colombia, ...?'''
| Are you from Peru? | '''¿(Tú) eres de Perú?'''
| I'm from Colombia. | '''(Yo) soy de Colombia.'''
| How nice! | '''¡Qué bien!'''
| And you? | '''¿Y tú?'''
| What? | '''¿Qué?'''
| Where are you from? | '''¿De dónde eres?'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Where are you from? | '''¿De dónde eres?'''
| Where am I from? | '''¿De dónde soy?'''
| From Peru, from Colombia, ...? | '''¿De Perú, de Colombia, ...?'''
| Are you from Peru? | '''¿(Tú) eres de Perú?'''
| I'm from Colombia. | '''(Yo) soy de Colombia.'''
| How nice! | '''¡Qué bien!'''
| And you? | '''¿Y tú?'''
| What? | '''¿Qué?'''
| Where are you from? | '''¿De dónde eres?'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recast====
This translation exercise requires some of the words from the [[#More Vocabulary|More Vocabulary]] section.
{{SbcQuestion
| Where are you from? (formal) | '''¿De dónde es (usted)?'''
| I'm from Peru. And you? (formal, plural) | '''Soy de Perú. ¿Y ustedes?'''
| We are from Colombia. | '''Nosotros somos de Colombia.'''
| How nice! | '''¡Qué bien!'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recast====
This translation exercise requires some of the words from the More Vocabulary section.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Where are you from? (formal) | '''¿De dónde es (usted)?'''
| I'm from Peru. And you? (formal, plural) | '''Soy de Perú. ¿Y ustedes?'''
| We are from Colombia. | '''Nosotros somos de Colombia.'''
| How nice! | '''¡Qué bien!'''
}}</includeonly>
